headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a 6-5 win over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 IP, 11 K, and 3 ER. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Toronto Blue Jays have transferred Addison Barger to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 22, 2026, with a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase is on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 21, 2026, with left plantar fasciitis. The Kansas City Royals have placed Bobby Witt Jr. on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 21, 2026, with low back tightness.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Ron Marinaccio has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded Max Martin to the Kansas City Royals for Nate Pearson. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres lost to the Atlanta Braves 6-5, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 IP, 11 K, and 3 ER. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the Twins' offense.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Rays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 3-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the team's offense. Locklear's impressive performance included 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Marinaccio Joins the Bucs**
top_news.summary: Ron Marinaccio has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for future considerations. The trade was finalized on July 23, 2026.
